# SW2URDF {{RELEASE_DATE}} Release Candidate / 候选版本

> **Draft only.** Publish only after manual SolidWorks validation and explicit maintainer approval.
>
> **当前仅为 Draft。** 必须完成 SolidWorks 手动验证，并由维护者明确确认“可以发布”后才能公开。

## English

### Added

- Added live Link collision previews for box, cylinder, sphere, and component-box strategies.
- Allowed collision preview, CAD bodies, COM marker, and inertia preview to remain visible together
  for pre-export fit inspection.
- Added automatic appearance loading from selected SolidWorks components/documents while preserving
  explicit user material, RGBA, and texture overrides in this candidate.
- Added a topmost export-progress window with current stage and elapsed time.
- Added a completion summary with changed file count, total size, elapsed time, and output directory.
- Kept ROS1 and ROS2 package output in one validated URDF/mesh export transaction.

### Fixed

- Fixed a SolidWorks 2023 Mass Properties API read-order failure that could return valid mass with a
  zero COM or inertia tensor.
- Fixed duplicate COM frame conversion when an assembly Link selected its own frame.
- Unified part and assembly mass, COM, and inertia frame conversion.
- Explicitly used meter, kilogram, and `kg*m^2` system units for Mass Properties queries.
- Preserved the physical tensor signs returned by the API when mapping to URDF and added an
  independent eigenvalue-to-API-principal-moment check.
- Stopped export when mass, COM, inertia, or selected-component bounds validation fails.
- Fitted primitive collision dimensions from the current Link's selected bodies instead of the
  complete assembly bounds.
- Replaced appearance-mutating collision previews with lightweight display geometry in this
  candidate.
- Added an explicit COM marker and simultaneous collision/inertia inspection.
- Fixed high-DPI overlap between the Link-frame selector and inertia-unit label.
- Isolated progress-window failures so a presentation error cannot turn a completed export into an
  export failure.

### Candidate Validation

- Debug build completed without compilation errors.
- 196 focused automated tests passed during feature integration.
- Final progress-window and layout tests passed 13/13.
- SolidWorks collision-preview and inertia Live API integration tests passed on the maintained test
  environment.
- CI verified installer SHA-256, provenance, extracted payload manifest, and every payload hash.

### Manual Validation Required Before Publication

- Test clean install, upgrade, and uninstall on the target SolidWorks versions.
- Restart SolidWorks and verify that the add-in is registered, listed, and loadable.
- Export ROS1 and ROS2 packages from representative part, assembly, and production models.
- Compare every Link's mass, COM, and inertia tensor with SolidWorks in multiple Link frames.
- Switch every Collision strategy and verify preview, formal geometry type, dimensions, and
  orientation.
- Verify appearance loading and explicit overrides supported by this candidate.
- Validate topmost progress, file count, total size, elapsed time, and failure reporting on a
  production-scale model.

## 简体中文

### 新增功能

- 增加 Link 碰撞几何在线预览，支持包围盒、圆柱体、球体和组件包围盒组合策略。
- 碰撞预览可以与 CAD 实体、质心标记、惯性预览同时显示，方便导出前检查拟合关系。
- 自动读取所选 SolidWorks 组件或文档的外观，同时保留该候选版本中的用户 material、RGBA 和
  纹理显式覆盖。
- 增加导出进度窗口，显示当前阶段和已用时间，并始终置顶于 SolidWorks 窗口。
- 增加导出完成摘要，显示本次生成或更新的文件数、总体大小、耗时和输出目录。
- ROS1 和 ROS2 功能包继续使用同一次经过验证的 URDF 与网格导出事务。

### 已修复问题

- 修复 SolidWorks 2023 质量属性 API 读取顺序导致质量正常但质心或惯性张量为零的问题。
- 修复装配体 Link 在选择自身坐标系后，质心被重复执行坐标变换的问题。
- 统一零件与装配体的质量、质心和惯性张量坐标系处理路线。
- 所有 SolidWorks 质量属性查询均显式使用米、千克和 `kg*m^2` 系统单位。
- 将 API 返回的物理张量符号原样映射到 URDF，并增加“张量特征值必须匹配 API 主惯量”的独立
  校验，防止重复符号转换。
- 当质量、质心、惯性张量或组件边界校验失败时停止导出，避免生成物理参数无效的 URDF。
- 修复碰撞原语尺寸错误引用装配体整体包围盒的问题，改为根据当前 Link 所选实体拟合。
- 在该候选版本中使用轻量显示几何替代会修改组件外观的碰撞预览。
- 增加显式质心标记，并允许碰撞体和惯性预览叠加显示。
- 修复高 DPI 下 Link 坐标系下拉菜单与惯性矩阵单位文字重叠的问题。
- 隔离进度窗口异常，避免显示层错误将已经完成的导出错误判定为失败。

### 候选包验证

- Debug 构建无编译错误。
- 功能集成阶段 196 项重点自动化测试通过。
- 最终进度窗口与布局测试 13/13 通过。
- 维护测试环境中的 SolidWorks 碰撞预览和惯性 Live API 集成测试通过。
- CI 已核对安装包 SHA-256、provenance、解包载荷清单及每个载荷文件哈希。

### 正式发布前必须完成的手动测试

- 在目标 SolidWorks 版本中测试首次安装、覆盖升级和卸载。
- 重启 SolidWorks，确认插件已经注册、出现在插件列表中并可正常加载。
- 使用典型零件、普通装配体和复杂生产装配体分别导出 ROS1 与 ROS2 功能包。
- 在多个 Link 坐标系下，将每个 Link 的质量、质心和惯性张量与 SolidWorks 逐项对照。
- 切换全部碰撞策略，确认预览、正式 geometry 类型、尺寸及方向。
- 验证该候选版本支持的外观自动载入和用户显式覆盖。
- 使用生产规模模型验证置顶进度窗口、文件数量、总体大小、耗时和失败路径提示。
